items.title: Undergraduate Researcher Recruitment
items.meta: Sophomore or above · 2 positions total (1 per topic) · Apply by October 8
items.detail:
Rehydratable Pasta (1 position): rehydration process and structure design, measurement of rehydration behavior and texture, and data-driven quality analysis.
Oleogel (1 position): evaluation of structuring, stability, dispersion, and rheological properties of oleogel-based food systems.
Please email your name, year, and preferred research topic.
